jsonLd.name: PRP + Laser Combination in Miami
jsonLd.description: The PRP + laser combination is a sequenced clinical protocol that pairs a Fotona Er:YAG micropeel with autologous platelet-rich plasma applied topically or via micro-injection, creating optimised absorption channels and amplifying the skin's regenerative response.

mainEntity.name: Why combine PRP with a laser instead of doing them separately?

acceptedAnswer.text: The Fotona micropeel creates uniform microchannels in the upper layers of the skin, which improves absorption of the platelet-rich plasma. Both treatments stimulate skin renewal through different mechanisms — laser thermal cascade and growth-factor signalling — and combining them in a single session amplifies the regenerative response while consolidating the recovery window into one period rather than two separate downtimes.

mainEntity.name: Is PRP safe? Are there allergy risks?

acceptedAnswer.text: PRP uses the patient's own blood, processed under sterile conditions, which means the risk of allergic reactions associated with the plasma itself is very low. The procedure is contraindicated in active infection, coagulation disorders, anticoagulant therapy, certain autoimmune conditions, pregnancy, and breastfeeding. A complete medical history at every visit ensures the protocol is suitable and the safest possible plan is designed for each patient.

mainEntity.name: How many sessions will I need?

acceptedAnswer.text: A protocol of two to three sessions spaced four to six weeks apart is generally recommended for optimal results. The exact number depends on your starting skin condition, age, and goals. Maintenance sessions every six to twelve months help sustain texture, tone, and luminosity improvements obtained during the initial protocol. Your personalised plan is designed during consultation in Miami and adjusted based on the response observed at each follow-up.

blocks.title: What it does for you
list: Enhances PRP absorption thanks to the laser microchannels created in the upper skin layers.
Combines two complementary regenerative mechanisms in a single session and a single recovery window.
Improves skin texture, fine lines, and overall luminosity progressively over the following weeks.
Supports skin tone and softens early photoageing changes such as dullness or irregular surface.
Uses the patient's own biological material, reducing the risk of allergic reactions associated with PRP itself.
Offers a controlled downtime period appropriate for adults with active social and professional lives.
Can be integrated into broader treatment plans alongside neuromodulators, fillers, or mesotherapy.
